From: Elena Park <elena.park@bluematrix.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluematrix.com
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP and close timing check-in

Jonas —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked us to share the Mutual Action Plan (attached) and confirm the current close target of 2027-06-30. We have a few items still open on our side (legal redlines, SOC2 evidence review) and I want to make sure we align on contingency if procurement needs more time.

Can you: 1) confirm Redwood's minimal required acceptance window (SOW/go-live gating items), 2) highlight any hard blockers that would force a longer delay, and 3) propose a delta plan if BlueMatrix slips by 2–4 weeks?

Attaching our working MAP (BM-MAP-v1.xlsx). Happy to hop on a quick call with procurement if helpful.

—Elena
Head of IT Procurement
BlueMatrix

Attachment: BM-MAP-v1.xlsx (Excel workbook, 18KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@bluematrix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-23T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and close timing check-in

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and for attaching the MAP. Quick summary up-front: 1) current target 2027-06-30 is still achievable on Redwood's side provided we get legal sign-off and SOC2 evidence review completed by 2027-06-10; 2) the only hard blocker would be a persistent legal covenant that requires a custom data residency flow (that would push to an on-prem/private eval and add 6–8 weeks); 3) 2–4 week slip plan below.

I've attached an updated MAP (Redwood-MAP-v2.xlsx) with callouts in the "Acceptance" column and a short delta plan. High-level delta plan (if BlueMatrix slips 2–4 weeks):
- Freeze non-critical onboarding tasks (training schedule, feature backlog) and preserve the cutover slot for a single compressed UAT run.
- Redwood will provision a short, high-priority engineering window for any integration fixes (2 engineer-days reserved during cutover week).
- Maintain SLA expectations but allow a 14-day soft acceptance period before final billing.

I'll also attach a preliminary risk log (map-risk-log-20270523.csv) that tracks the legal/SOC items. Marissa/Ben — looped you both for procurement/legal coordination and to flag escalation if the procurement window expands beyond 4 weeks.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min procurement sync tomorrow (I have 10:30–11:00 or 15:00–15:30 PT).

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v2.xlsx (Excel workbook, 22KB); map-risk-log-20270523.csv (CSV, 4KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: FW: MAP and close timing check-in / internal escalation notes

Folks — internal note before we send a follow-up to BlueMatrix:

1) Legal: I'll patch in with counsel today; the redlines look standard but procurement wants an explicit SLA credit clause frequency that Legal is debating. If Legal pushes a non-standard clause, that's our main schedule risk.
2) Security: SOC2 evidence request is routine; Security has the packet and expects to deliver by 2027-06-02. If Security finds gaps we may need a short attestation addendum.
3) Contingency: Recommend we pre-authorize the 2 engineer-days Jonas flagged and document the cost/approval path now so procurement can't push back in the cutover week.

Laura — please confirm whether Finance is okay with the proposed 14-day soft acceptance before final invoicing; if not, we should update the MAP to reflect billing contingencies.

Action items (internal):
- Marissa to send legal summary and recommended redline positions (EOD 2027-05-24).
- Ben to prepare the 2-engineer-day escalation commitment and estimate cost impact (2027-05-25).
- Laura to confirm Finance billing tolerance (2027-05-25).

I'll draft a concise update to Elena once we have legal's guidance (aiming 2027-05-25 morning).

—Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Quoted message below for context.

From: Elena Park <elena.park@bluematrix.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluematrix.com
Date: 2027-05-25T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and close timing check-in

Jonas/Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the delta plan. Procurement ran a quick internal review this morning: they are asking for an extra two weeks on the procurement/legal review (new internal target 2027-07-14 close). They said the SOC2 packet will be completed as planned.

We want to avoid repeatedly re-baselining the go-live, so two asks: 1) can Redwood hold current provisioning (no cost) through 2027-07-01 and then move to a reserved cutover window between 2027-07-12 and 2027-07-19 if legal isn't finished by 07/01? 2) If we accept the 14-day soft acceptance period, can you confirm invoicing cadence and whether we can expect any invoicing delays tied to final acceptance?

If this is acceptable we'll update the MAP file and circulate a signed mutual action plan.

Best,
Elena
